name: AMC Marquee Links
description: An announcement ticker: the list's links glide past in a seamless loop with faded edges and a live pulse, and pause on hover, keyboard focus or the pause button.
useFor: A single strip of announcements, quick links or partner and supplier links at the top of a home page, portal or dashboard; 4 to 12 short entries.
helpText: List template for an announcement or quick-link ticker. The entries scroll sideways in a seamless loop (the JavaScript file repeats the entries with copies that are hidden from screen readers and skipped by the Tab key), reverse direction in right-to-left languages, and pause while the pointer is over the strip, while a link has keyboard focus, or after the pause button is pressed. Use the Tag attribute (A01) for a short label such as New, Due today or Partner shown as a chip before the text. Template options: Slow and Fast change the speed, Reverse scrolls the other way, Band paints a solid primary-color strip, and Plain removes the frame for use inside a page header. Without JavaScript, and under reduced motion, the entries sit still as a wrapped row of links. The pause button label is English text in the After List Entries template; translate it there if needed.

templateOptions.name: Slow
templateOptions.help: Scrolls at about 60 percent of the normal speed, for longer texts.

templateOptions.name: Fast
templateOptions.help: Scrolls at about 1.7 times the normal speed, for short logos and names.

templateOptions.name: Band
templateOptions.help: A solid strip in the primary color with contrast text, like a news band.

templateOptions.name: Plain
templateOptions.help: No background, border or pulse; the ticker blends into a page header or hero.
